title: Cumulative Marginal Matching for One-Step Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.34575v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The sampling procedures of diffusion and flow-matching models involve hundreds of denoising steps incurring substantial inference time, which has motivated a growing body of work on training schemes for few-step and one-step generation. Existing approaches primarily seek to align the generation trajectory of few-step and base models, yet their training objectives only involve discrepancies at a single point in the trajectory, encouraging only local \emph{point-level} alignment. While recent methods such as \emph{Shortcut-CSL} introduce cumulative objective that enforce alignment over the entire trajectory, this is suboptimal as they do not directly enforce alignment between the distributions induced by the two models throughout the generation process. translated_title: 面向单步扩散的累积边缘匹配
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流匹配模型的采样过程涉及数百个去噪步骤，导致推理时间过长，这促使了越来越多关于少步生成和单步生成训练方案的研究。现有方法主要致力于对齐少步模型与基础模型的生成轨迹，然而其训练目标仅涉及轨迹上单点之间的差异，只能实现局部的“点级”对齐。尽管近期方法（如 Shortcut-CSL）引入了在整个轨迹上强制对齐的累积目标，但这仍然是次优的，因为它们并未直接强制对齐两个模型在整个生成过程中所诱导的分布。我们提出了累积边缘匹配（CMM），这是一个用于少步生成的原则性训练目标：通过将流匹配视为一系列连接…
tldr: 提出累积边缘匹配（CMM）训练目标，通过在整个生成过程中直接对齐少步模型与基础模型所诱导的中间边缘分布，克服现有方法仅做单点局部对齐的局限，实现高质量的单步扩散生成。
en_tdlr: Proposes Cumulative Marginal Matching (CMM), a principled objective that directly aligns the intermediate marginal distributions induced by few-step and base models throughout the entire generation process, overcoming the limitation of existing point-level trajectory alignment methods for one-step diffusion generation.
